The *Revatīvimānavatthu* (“Revatī’s Mansion”, Vv 52) is a verse text belonging to the *Vimānavatthu* in the Pali canon. The text conveys the karmic theme that greed, evil conduct, and the failure to maintain moral precepts inevitably culminate in suffering.

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
